name: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/are/simulation/validation/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_BaseJudgeState: create a BaseJudgeState dataclass to track judge state including turns, oracle events, and agent events
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.implement_BaseJudge_subclass: implement a BaseJudge subclass that overrides initialize_state and __call__ to compare agent and oracle event logs
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.validate_scenario_with_BaseJudge: validate a scenario by calling BaseJudge.validate with an AbstractEnvironment to get a ScenarioValidationResult
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.implement_ToolJudge_subclass: implement a ToolJudge subclass that overrides compare to decide if agent and oracle tool call events match
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.implement_EventJudge_subclass: implement an EventJudge subclass that overrides compare to decide if agent and oracle events of a given type match

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_judge_engine: create a judge engine using LiteLLM with a default Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct model or custom LLMEngineConfig
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_ToolCheckerParam: create a ToolCheckerParam dataclass to configure hard judge parameter checking with arg name, checker type, and tool name
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_SoftToolJudgeConfig: create a SoftToolJudgeConfig dataclass to configure soft tool judging with an LLM engine and content checker types
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_ScriptedGraphPerEventJudgeConfig: create a ScriptedGraphPerEventJudgeConfig dataclass to configure scripted graph event judging with required event ID checker parameters
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_InContextJudgeConfig: create an InContextJudgeConfig dataclass to configure in-context judging with time thresholds and per-tool evaluation criteria

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_tool_registry: create a ToolRegistry instance with initial checker data and app and tool aliases
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.add_tool_alias: add an alias for an existing tool function name in the ToolRegistry
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.add_app_alias: add an alias for an existing app name across all its tool functions in the registry
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.check_checker_type: check if a CheckerType enum value is a hard or scripted checker using is_hard or is_scripted
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.lookup_soft_checker_types: lookup the soft checker types for a given tool in the TOOL_SOFT_CHECKER_TYPE_REGISTRY

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_EnvUserEventJudge: create an EnvUserEventJudge instance to compare environment user events by event ID equality
